about: Lane I18b: six unrelated goals for the plan-time candidate fixes. The space jobs, their search words, the list rows and the GitHub finds are the ones in the owner's live test3 build 20261027-155349-af5ae7 (names and descriptions as the projects publish them, shortened; topics filled in so the fake search finds them as GitHub did; example/issue-tracker stands in for the issue trackers it found). The other five goals are made the same way. 'yes' is what the brain double says yes to on the app ask, 'code_yes' on the code ask; everything else gets a no, as the live brain answered.
